name: RAPP Shot
summary: Capture, annotate and redact screenshots entirely on-device. Finds credentials in the pixels with Apple's Vision OCR and paints them out opaquely BEFORE the image is shared. Redaction is a solid fill, never a blur, because blur and pixelation are reversible often enough to have leaked real credentials.
tagline: Capture, annotate and redact screenshots entirely on-device.
egg_note: Ships with no state. The egg is the hatch cartridge only — no captures, recordings, transcripts, vocabulary or personal data.
